content.short: UR is a crypto-and-fiat neobank with Swiss IBAN accounts, a Mastercard and USDe stablecoin support.
content.description: UR is a blockchain-based neobank, launched with backing from Mantle, that unifies crypto and fiat money in a single account bridging traditional finance and DeFi. Based in Zurich, it gives users Swiss IBAN accounts with multi-currency support, a Mastercard for everyday spending, on and off ramps between digital assets and fiat, and SEPA and SWIFT access. Through a partnership with Ethena, UR integrates the USDe stablecoin so users can hold digital dollars, with settlement anchored on the Mantle network. Positioned for globally minded users across many countries, it lets people spend, save and move value across fiat and stablecoins from one account, combining bank-grade rails with on-chain finance.
